intro_same: Practice: the same Indigo Ledger capstone, with harder questions. Like the walkthrough it has no hints: each answer needs a time worked out or two files joined.

ask: How many minutes after the cloud alert did the SOC acknowledge it?
How many minutes after that was the incident declared?
On what date should intern.payroll have been switched off? (YYYY-MM-DD)
Which VPN address was the intruder given?
How many seconds after opening backup-config.ps1 did the attacker open readme.txt?
Which file did the attacker write on pay-app01? (file name)
Which access key ID read the bucket?
How many MB were read from the bucket?
How many whole hours did the intruder's VPN session last? (round down)
How many employees of the RBI-regulated client were in the exports?
How many EU staff on secondment were in the exports?
